Seeding: seed_data.json has "snippets": [] and server.js lines 147-168 only create tables, so there are no seeded rows to vary; record ids are AUTOINCREMENT and revisions are counters. Nondeterministic sources exist but none feeds a pinned graded value: server.js lines 71, 84, 111 store new Date().toISOString() in updated_at, used for library ordering with an id tie-break (line 65); crypto.randomUUID() is used for console entry keys, preview nonces and run tokens and the restore operationId (app.tsx:45,85; runtime.ts:27,317,318,335,386); performance.now() measures run duration (runtime.ts:382-402). A search of all judge.toml files and app_context.md finds no criterion that pins a timestamp, elapsed figure, UUID or absolute record id; the task defines no fixed clock and none of its graded rules is time-based apart from tolerance windows (five-second run budget, about-five-second library refresh) that are stated as approximate.
